Speaker: DON GIOVANNI
Text: You're finally awake. Don't look at me like that - this isn't the first time we've met. Don't you remember?

Speaker: DON GIOVANNI
Text: They say I am guilty. That I should stay here forever. But they only remember what I did - never why I did it.

Speaker: DON GIOVANNI
Text: So I need someone without prejudice. Someone who doesn't remember the past, and doesn't know me.

Speaker: DON GIOVANNI
Text: These masks - put them on, and you will see what others saw. And what I saw.

Speaker: DON GIOVANNI
Text: Go and see those stories. Then come back and tell me: do I truly not deserve forgiveness?
Change the mask. Does the truth change with it?

Speaker: COMMENDATORE
Text: Stop! You shameless wretch - you wanted to violate my daughter, and you think you can simply leave?

Speaker: DON GIOVANNI
Text: Out of my way, old man. Let me go.

Speaker: COMMENDATORE
Text: Draw your sword! Come and fight me!

Speaker: DON GIOVANNI
Text: You asked for this yourself!

Speaker: (don mask)
Text: He drew first. Steel against steel, man against man.

Speaker: (don mask)
Text: I gave him every chance to walk away. This was a duel - nothing more.

Speaker: (anna mask)
Text: Father?

Speaker: (anna mask)
Text: A moment ago this was our home. Now every wall is closing in,

Speaker: (anna mask)
Text: and the only way out is the one he is standing in.

Speaker: (servant mask)
Text: I could only watch through the cracks. The blade. His chest. The sound.

Speaker: (servant mask)
Text: I did nothing. What could a servant do?

Speaker: DON GIOVANNI
Text: You saw it. I had no choice. He wanted to kill me - I could only defend myself.

Speaker: DON GIOVANNI
Text: Go on. I'll be watching you.

Speaker: FIRST SHADOW
Text: Mercy, sirs - I am not the man you want!

Speaker: SECOND SHADOW
Text: Nor am I. Look closer - I am only the servant.

Speaker: (don mask)
Text: A cloak, a hat, a borrowed voice - and the whole town chases the wrong man.

Speaker: (don mask)
Text: Is it a crime to be clever?

Speaker: (servant mask)
Text: His coat is heavy, and every lantern in the town is turned on me.

Speaker: (servant mask)
Text: If they hang me, they will hang his name. No one will ask for mine.

Speaker: (anna mask)
Text: There he is again, above us, laughing in another man's clothes.

Speaker: (anna mask)
Text: We can shout as loud as we like. He never has to come down.
Which of them is Don Giovanni?

Speaker: DON GIOVANNI
Text: What of it? He got away in the end, didn't he? No one died... not this time.

Speaker: THE SHADOW
Text: You have seen everything. Now, tell me - should Don Giovanni be forgiven?
I have no right to forgive him on behalf of those he hurt.

Speaker: THE COMMENDATORE
Text: So. Even you cannot absolve yourself.

Speaker: DON GIOVANNI
Text: No! No! I gave you my memories, my thoughts, my voice - you are part of me!

Speaker: DON GIOVANNI
Text: Why won't even you forgive me? You are me. You were my last chance. No-!
No one can forgive on behalf of the wounded.
